title: Prompt and Carrying True-Up Shares on a Micro Market Settlement
content:
How regularly a client has settled its Unattended Micro Market Program invoices over the trailing year, together with the balance standing unsettled on the agreement, can move the share at which the client discount met is taken into the product settlement.

## Conditions and shares

**The prompt true-up share of 97 per cent** applies where the client settled at or above 3 market settlement invoices over the twelve months to the day the settlement is raised, and the balance standing unsettled on the agreement is below the minimum funding lot printed against the market format. Both limbs must hold.

**The carrying true-up share of 103 per cent** applies where the client settled at or below 1 market settlement invoice over those twelve months, or the balance standing unsettled on the agreement is at or above the minimum funding lot printed against the market format. Either limb on its own is enough.

**Where neither condition holds**, neither the prompt share nor the carrying share is taken.

## The boundaries in figures

The prompt settlement count is 3 settlement payments over the trailing twelve months, a year carrying exactly 3 meeting it and a year carrying 2 not. The slow settlement count is 1, a year carrying 1 payment or none meeting it and a year carrying 2 not. The balance standing unsettled is compared with the minimum funding lot printed against the market format, a balance standing exactly at that figure counting as at or above it.

*Hypothetical.* A client settling 5 invoices over the trailing twelve months with 300.00 USD standing unsettled, against a printed minimum funding lot of 4200.00 USD, takes 97 per cent. Had 5200.00 USD been standing unsettled, the second limb of the carrying condition would be met and 103 per cent would be taken. A client settling 2 invoices with 300.00 USD standing unsettled meets neither condition.
